project_title: Multi-Tenant SaaS Website Editor Information Architecture & Visual Layout Blueprint
archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / SOFT UTILITY (Light Mode Admin Dashboard)
context: saas_app (internal admin/builder screen for small service contractors)

typography.heading_font: Plus Jakarta Sans, Outfit, or system-ui sans-serif (font-bold / font-heading)

visual_enhancers.card_style: bg-white border border-slate-200/80 rounded-2xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-200
visual_enhancers.sticky_header_style: sticky top-0 z-30 bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-slate-200/80 px-4 py-3 shadow-xs
visual_enhancers.ai_card_banner: bg-gradient-to-br from-violet-600 via-indigo-600 to-blue-700 text-white rounded-2xl p-6 shadow-lg shadow-indigo-500/10

target_structure_5_tabs.description: Unified AI generation hub: brief input, Instagram media import, stock photo autofill, ES/EN translations, and image localization.
components: AIBriefSection (AI Prompt + Instagram URL)
AIGenerateActionCard (Main AI site generator trigger)
StockPhotoAutofillAction (Auto-fills stock photos for missing slots)
BilingualTranslationSuite (Translate ES <-> EN actions)
ImageLocalizerAction (Downloads remote images to local storage)
AIDesignSuggestionsBanner (Smart template & color palette recommendation)

target_structure_5_tabs.description: THE CORE EDITOR: Re-orderable, collapsible accordion list of all 13+ website sections. Mirrors the intuitive 'Servicios' accordion pattern.
components: AccordionSectionList (Main container with drag/up-down reordering)
HeroSectionCard (Headline, Tagline, Subheadline, Call to Action, Hero Photo, BG Color)
AboutSectionCard (About text, Team/About Photos, BG Color)
ServicesSectionCard (Services list, /servicio/ page colors, AI service suggestions)
SolutionsSectionCard ('Problemas que resolvemos' / Problem pages & case studies)
GallerySectionCard (Recent work gallery, photo ordering, AI photo captions)
BeforeAfterSectionCard (Before/After image comparison pairs)
StatsBandSectionCard (Key statistics & counter badges, BG Color)
ReviewsSectionCard (Google Reviews & client testimonials)
ContactSectionCard (Location pin, phone, working hours, service area)
HowItWorksSectionCard (Process steps 1-2-3)
FaqSectionCard (Frequently asked questions list)
ServiceAreasSectionCard (List of cities & zip codes served)
LogosSectionCard (Partner & client trust logos)

target_structure_5_tabs.description: Global visual styling: Template selection, brand accent colors, curated template palettes, and global section background colors.
components: TemplateSelectorGrid (11 template thumbnails: agency, cinematic, responder, bento, craftsman, trust, slider, onepage, neon, playful, luxe)
BrandColorPalettePicker (Template recommended palettes + preset swatches + custom color picker)
GlobalSectionColorMatrix (Per-section background color pickers with automatic text contrast adjustment)
AIDesignSuggestionModal (One-click AI aesthetic match)

target_structure_5_tabs.description: Interactive lead generation features and widget settings.
components: ContactFormToggle (Toggle quotes & lead intake form)
BookingToggle (Toggle online appointment booking + digital card link)
AIChatbotSettingsCard (Toggle AI assistant, launcher badge, avatar photo, position left/right, Spanish & English greetings)

target_structure_5_tabs.description: Site status control, domain routing, sitemap, and version control.
components: PublishStatusToggle (Draft vs Published status switch)
PublicUrlCard (Live URL preview, copy link button, custom slug editor)
CustomDomainsBilingualSuite (Primary EN Domain + Secondary ES Domain connectors)
SitemapPanel (Interactive page route hierarchy viewer)
VersionHistoryDrawer (Backup restore points & snapshot history)

left_elements: ReorderButtons (ArrowUp & ArrowDown icons for precise mobile shifting)
SectionIcon (Specific Lucide icon, e.g., Briefcase for Services, Users for About)
right_elements: StatusBadge ('Activa' emerald badge vs 'Oculta' slate badge)
ExpandChevron (ChevronDown icon with smooth 180deg rotate transition)
header_collapsed.interaction: Click anywhere on header (except switches/buttons) to expand/collapse

body_expanded.padding: p-5 border-t border-slate-100 bg-white space-y-5 rounded-b-2xl

group_1_text_content.heading: 1. Textos y Contenido
group_1_text_content.fields: Inputs / Textareas with integrated 'AiBtn' (Sparkles icon for AI auto-write)

group_2_media_assets.heading: 2. Fotos e Imágenes
group_2_media_assets.fields: Single PhotoField or PhotoMultiField picker with upload dropzone + gallery picker modal

group_3_styling_color.heading: 3. Color de Fondo de la Sección
group_3_styling_color.fields: Inline ColorPicker (`section_colors[key]`) with preset swatches and contrast preview

spacing_and_layout.container_max_width: max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 py-6 space-y-6
spacing_and_layout.top_nav_bar: flex items-center gap-2 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar py-2
spacing_and_layout.input_height: h-11 sm:h-12 rounded-xl text-sm border-slate-200 focus:border-blue-600 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-100

testing_attributes.rule: ALL interactive components MUST have explicit data-testid attributes

instructions_to_main_agent: Execute the REORGANIZATION of `WebsiteEditor.js` into the target 5 tabs as requested by the user.
Do NOT delete or omit ANY existing backend API integration, hook, or state field.
Implement Tab 2 ('Secciones del sitio') as a high-density, accessible Accordion list where each card consolidates text + photos + section background color + on/off switch.
Ensure all data-testid attributes from the previous implementation are maintained or updated to match the new 5-tab structure so automated tests pass smoothly.
Maintain clean light mode aesthetic with slate-900 text, slate-100/200 borders, blue-600 primary accents, emerald-600 success actions, and smooth micro-interactions.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts or unstyled default components.
Ensure generous internal card padding (p-5 or p-6) to prevent text collision with borders.
Use specific CSS transitions (e.g. `transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease`), NEVER universal `transition: all`.
Ensure full touch accessibility on mobile devices with minimum 44px hit targets for accordion headers, switches, and buttons.
All state mutations must trigger smooth toast feedback using `sonner`.
